# IGO Nursery

> IGO Nursery is an AgriTech plant nursery based in Muttukadu, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. It grows plants under IoT-monitored conditions and sells plants, seeds, pots and planters, plant-care products, gardening tools and gifts online, with delivery across India.

Website: https://www.igonursery.com/
Location: ECR Road, Muttukadu, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 603112, India
Phone: +91 73973 86189
Email: ceojohnyesudas@gmail.com

## What we offer
- Plants: indoor, outdoor, flowering, fruit, succulents, cactus, palms, bonsai, orchids, herbs, medicinal and many more
- Seeds: vegetable, flower, herb, fruit, microgreens, lawn grass and more
- Pots and planters, plant-care products (fertilisers, soil, pest control), gardening tools
- Garden services and landscaping, gifting and corporate gifts
- Plant Finder: a guided tool to pick plants by light, space and maintenance

## Delivery and policies
- Delivery across India; same-day delivery is available within a 30 km radius of the nursery.
- Cash on Delivery is available for Chennai only; other locations are prepaid.
- Damaged plants are replaced when reported with photo proof within 24-48 hours of delivery (no refunds).
- [Shipping policy](https://www.igonursery.com/shipping-policy)
- [Privacy policy](https://www.igonursery.com/privacy-policy)
